ns2:section.sectionText: Registration by instructor permission. Please note: Students who have completed JOUR 460 KRE GMI-TV Prod Producing (SP20 64206) should not register for JOUR 417. While the numbers are different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit and will not count toward graduation. Students registering for the duplicate credit course will be asked to drop. *Students must register for a lecture and a discussion/lab section.
